items.text: November 6 Improvements and Fixes
1. Fixed an issue where DLSS Frame Generation did not work.
2. Fixed an issue that caused stuttering on some laptops.

5. Fixed an issue with incorrect calculations for Dewple’s "Rapids Dewdrop" skill.
6. Fixed an issue where the controller radial menu at the Park did not work correctly.
